about.director_text: Angren City Specialized School is a state specialized school under Uzbekistan's specialized education system. Our school focuses on providing advanced education, particularly in STEM-related subjects such as mathematics, physics, information technology, and other specialized disciplines.
about.mission_text: To prepare talented students for national and international Olympiads and university admission. We use the most advanced teaching methods to unlock every student's potential.

whyus.section_subtitle: We offer the best opportunities for quality education
whyus.item1_desc: Advanced education in mathematics, physics, IT and natural sciences
whyus.item2_desc: Professional preparation for national and international olympiads
whyus.item3_desc: Education is free for all students admitted through the official selection process
whyus.item4_desc: Highly qualified and experienced teaching staff

education.section_subtitle: Core subjects and specializations taught at our school
education.math_desc: Algebra, geometry, mathematical analysis and olympiad mathematics
education.physics_desc: Theoretical and applied physics, laboratory sessions
education.it_desc: Programming, algorithms, fundamentals of computer science
education.biology_desc: General biology, genetics and biotechnology fundamentals
education.languages_desc: Uzbek, Russian, English — advanced language instruction

admission.section_subtitle: How to apply: from online application to entrance exams
admission.step1_desc: Submit your application through the my.gov.uz portal
admission.step2_desc: Passport photo, birth certificate, school report card
admission.step3_desc: Exams in mathematics, native language, and logical reasoning
admission.step4_desc: Students are admitted based on their exam scores and available places
admission.grades_text: Admission is available for grades 5–11. Some science-focused programs begin from Grade 7.
admission.free_text: Education is completely free for all students admitted through the official selection process.
